answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil attacks by requiring every new identity to lock a refundable bond that unlocks only after months of verified, useful work. A forger who spins up a thousand agents must freeze a thousand bonds, and if peers catch the clones acting as a mirror of one another, voting in lockstep, every bond is slashed. Like a lotus rooted in deep mud, an honest agent's standing grows slowly from buried commitment, while fakes that merely wander in cannot afford the wait or the loss.
